# eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint AI SDK security rules for the Vercel AI SDK — detects prompt injection, system-prompt leaks, hardcoded API keys, and unvalidated model output in generateText and streamText.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import vercelAiSecurity from 'eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security';

export default [vercelAiSecurity.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `vercel-ai-security/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

Use it alongside `eslint-plugin-security`, not instead of it: keep that plugin if the project has it. Measured overlap and the limits of both: https://eslint.interlace.tools/docs/getting-started/with-eslint-plugin-security

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `flagship`    | 1     | 1      | 0        |
| `minimal`     | 2     | 2      | 0        |
| `recommended` | 10    | 8      | 2        |
| `strict`      | 19    | 18     | 1        |

### `flagship`

1 rule:

- `no-unsafe-output-handling` (error): Prevent using AI output directly in dangerous operations (eval, SQL, HTML).

### `minimal`

2 rules:

- `require-validated-prompt` (error): Require validated/sanitized prompts in generateText and streamText calls.
- `no-hardcoded-api-keys` (error): Prevent hardcoded API keys in AI SDK model configuration.

### `recommended`

10 rules:

- `require-validated-prompt` (error): Require validated/sanitized prompts in generateText and streamText calls.
- `no-hardcoded-api-keys` (error): Prevent hardcoded API keys in AI SDK model configuration.
- `no-unsafe-output-handling` (error): Prevent using AI output directly in dangerous operations (eval, SQL, HTML).
- `no-sensitive-in-prompt` (error): Prevent sensitive data (secrets, credentials, PII) from being passed to LLM prompts.
- `no-system-prompt-leak` (error): Prevent system prompts from being exposed in API responses or client code.
- `no-dynamic-system-prompt` (error): Prevent dynamic content in system prompts to avoid agent confusion attacks.
- `require-tool-confirmation` (error): Require human confirmation for destructive tool operations (delete, transfer, execute).
- `require-tool-schema` (error): Require inputSchema (Zod schema) for all AI SDK tools.
- `require-max-tokens` (warn): Require maxTokens limit in generateText and streamText calls.
- `require-rag-content-validation` (warn): Require validation of RAG content before including in AI prompts.

### `strict`

Everything in `recommended` plus 9 more (some shared rules run at a different severity here):

- `require-max-steps` (error): Disallow unbounded multi-step tool loops (hasToolCall-only stop conditions, request-controlled step limits).
- `require-output-filtering` (error): Require filtering of sensitive data returned by AI tools.
- `no-training-data-exposure` (error): Prevent user data from being sent to LLM training endpoints.
- `require-request-timeout` (error): Require timeout configuration for AI SDK calls to prevent DoS.
- `require-embedding-validation` (error): Require validation of embeddings before storage or similarity search.
- `require-output-validation` (error): Require validation of AI output before displaying to users.
- `require-error-handling` (error): Require error handling for AI SDK calls to prevent cascading failures.
- `require-abort-signal` (error): Require AbortSignal for streaming AI calls to enable proper cleanup.
- `require-audit-logging` (warn): Suggest audit logging for AI SDK operations.

## Other Interlace plugins by dependency

If the project also depends on one of these, add the matching plugin the same way:

- `express`, `fastify`, `koa`, `@hapi/hapi`, `restify`, `hono`, `next`, `@nestjs/core`, `@nestjs/common`, `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`, `commander`, `yargs`, `@oclif/core`, `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-node-security`
- `express`: `eslint-plugin-express-security`
- `@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs/core`: `eslint-plugin-nestjs-security`
- `react`, `react-dom`, `preact`, `vue`, `svelte`, `@angular/core`, `solid-js`, `lit`, `next`, `nuxt`: `eslint-plugin-browser-security`
- `jsonwebtoken`, `jose`, `express-jwt`, `@nestjs/jwt`, `jwks-rsa`, `jwt-decode`: `eslint-plugin-jwt-security`
- `pg`, `pg-pool`, `pg-promise`, `postgres`, `slonik`: `eslint-plugin-postgresql-security`
- `mysql2`, `mysql`: `eslint-plugin-mysql-security`
- `mongodb`, `mongoose`: `eslint-plugin-mongodb-security`
- `better-sqlite3`, `sqlite3`: `eslint-plugin-sqlite-security`
- `knex`: `eslint-plugin-knex-security`
- `@prisma/client`, `prisma`: `eslint-plugin-prisma-security`
- `drizzle-orm`: `eslint-plugin-drizzle-security`
- `sequelize`: `eslint-plugin-sequelize-security`
- `typeorm`: `eslint-plugin-typeorm-security`
- `@supabase/supabase-js`: `eslint-plugin-supabase-security`
- `@grpc/grpc-js`, `@grpc/reflection`, `grpc-server-reflection`: `eslint-plugin-grpc-security`
- `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-mcp-sdk-security`
- `openai`, `@openai/agents`: `eslint-plugin-openai-security`
- `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`: `eslint-plugin-anthropic-security`
- `@google/genai`: `eslint-plugin-gemini-security`
- `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`: `eslint-plugin-lambda-security`

The full stack-to-plugin playbook (with config rendering and a proof step) is the `security-linting` skill: https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/skills/security-linting
